content.text: {"summary":"The Ship-It Squad builds a simple hello page, with quick design and accessibility checks before it ships.","items":[{"text":"Build index.html that says hello","assignee":"a-semic","teamId":"ship-it","brief":"Create one index.html page that clearly says hello. Keep it simple and small. Done when the page opens in a browser, shows the hello message, and main stays green. Park any extra ideas in issues.txt."},{"text":"Give the hello page a friendly look","assignee":"a-twinkle","brief":"Suggest a light, clean style for the hello page, like font, colors, and spacing. Keep it to one page and no extras. Done when the page looks tidy and welcoming, and the changes are handed to the Ship-It Squad."},{"text":"Check the page is easy for everyone to use","assignee":"a-ally-alt-text","brief":"Review the hello page for basic accessibility: a page title, a language set, a clear heading, good color contrast, and alt text on any images. Done when any issues are listed and fixed, or confirmed as fine."},{"text":"Ship and demo the hello page","assignee":"a-semic","teamId":"ship-it","brief":"Ship the finished page behind a flag. Make sure main is still green. One person gives a short demo showing the hello message. Done when the demo is complete and the page is live behind the flag."}]}
